title: Chemical entity and retained identity
statement: A chemical entity is the least singular Fold carrier that remains separately distinguishable after constitution, isotopic identity and the observation context's required precision are retained.
generation_rule: Generate the literal product of the registered entity carrier, constitution, isotope, distinction, precision, record, provenance and extension choices.
grammar_boundary: Every finite singular chemical carrier formed from admitted distinctions and any generated positive-finite extension of its constitution, isotope, state or contextual precision record.

choices.name: ensemble-without-member
choices.reason: An ensemble alone does not identify one chemical entity.

choices.name: singular-carrier
choices.reason: One entity is one retained carrier before any ensemble quotient.

choices.name: constitution-erased
choices.reason: Erasing constitution merges chemically distinct carriers.

choices.name: constitution-retained
choices.reason: Constitution is a required chemical identity coordinate.

choices.name: isotope-erased
choices.reason: Erasing isotopic identity merges distinguishable entities.

choices.name: isotope-retained
choices.reason: Isotopic distinction remains available whenever the observation resolves it.

choices.name: indistinguishable-answer-label
choices.reason: An answer label without a retained distinction cannot identify an entity.

choices.name: separately-distinguishable
choices.reason: The carrier must remain separately distinguishable at the registered observation boundary.

choices.name: unbounded-or-fixed-precision
choices.reason: A fixed universal precision either loses a required distinction or adds an unforced one.

choices.name: context-bounded-precision
choices.reason: Only distinctions required by the declared observation context are retained.

choices.name: result-without-observation-record
choices.reason: Without an observation record the identity boundary cannot be audited.

choices.name: held-observation-record
choices.reason: The observation class and retained coordinates remain held.

choices.name: unbound-provenance
choices.reason: Unbound identity cannot be traced to the Fold dependency spine.

choices.name: source-bound-proof-trace
choices.reason: The derivation and later correspondence retain separate source identities.

choices.name: free-extra-identity-rule
choices.reason: An extra identity rule can arbitrarily split or merge entities.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: Generated distinctions alone determine the identity carrier.

induction_base: One registered chemical carrier retains one constitution/isotope/context identity record.
induction_step: Adding one generated identity coordinate preserves the singular carrier and every earlier distinction without installing a new equivalence rule.
exclusions: no IUPAC definition, conventional chemistry model or target content may select a candidate
no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
no free, fitted, learned or target-derived parameter
no application result or opaque predictor
external target content is absent from this specification and opens only through post-seal custody
Every finite singular chemical carrier formed from admitted distinctions and any generated positive-finite extension of its constitution, isotope, state or contextual precision record.
operational_witnesses: context may require an additional retained state coordinate
falsification_condition: The claim fails if the current source-derived IUPAC entity record lacks singular distinguishability, constitution/isotope identity or contextual precision, or if any altered row is accepted.
